# Admin Insights

## GET `/api/v1/admin/billing/revenue`
Revenue from AI allowance purchases: overview, time series and order statuses
- operationId: `getAdminBillingRevenue`
- Params: `query:from (string)`, `query:to (string)`, `query:granularity (string)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → AdminBillingRevenueResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `422` → ErrorResponse

## GET `/api/v1/admin/ai/usage`
Paginated per-user AI usage trace with allowance source and outcome
- operationId: `listAdminAiUsage`
- Params: `query:page (integer)`, `query:limit (integer)`, `query:feature (string)`, `query:outcome (string)`, `query:user (string)`, `query:from (string)`, `query:to (string)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → AdminAiUsageTraceResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `422` → ErrorResponse
